prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sprite sheet called The Recess Petition. Original image inputs guide complete footless continuous charcoal-plum splat silhouettes, tiny goo hands, thick sculpted filled eyelids, ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil. The fictional Schülerdemo are conveyed through relative body proportions, facial attitude and props. All are soft organic ink blobs with simple age-appropriate clothing accents. No actual humans. Six independent full characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet, 1536×1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Equal substantial scale within this sheet. Keep silhouettes and all props within generous clear alpha gutters and canvas margins. No background scene, shadow disc, frame, text, logo or branding. Smooth softly satin handmade plasticine with sparse larger modeled marks, broad fabric folds, smooth glass and finished plastic. No grit or crust. Teeth behind lips. No inherited reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Warm brick, sunflower, mint and navy. Casual pupil clothes, compact peaceable school-issue placards with wordless pictograms.
Row-major cast:
1. Male-read recess advocate. wide determined splat, forward gaze, open calling mouth. Key cue: small handheld placard with a bold clock pictogram.
2. Female-read crossing safety petitioner. tall upright curl, steady direct eyes and firm closed lips. Key cue: short sign with a simple zebra crossing pictogram.
3. Male-read school lunch campaigner. plump uneven pear, plaintive raised eyebrows and small pout. Key cue: miniature placard showing a plain bowl and spoon.
4. Male-read petition clipboard keeper. square low blob, focused eyes and tight frown. Key cue: small clipboard with large blank boxes and pencil.
5. Female-read peaceful sign maker. upright soft droplet, sharp side glance and confident smile. Key cue: one compact board with a large chalk nub and a simple schoolyard tree picture.
6. Male-read nervous spokesperson. lean crooked blob, worried raised eyelids and hesitant small O mouth. Key cue: one little cone-shaped megaphone with rounded edge held at chest.
All six whole ink blobs are distinct and easy to isolate. Simple readable surreal props and varied expressions.
